A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the RieszNet method is a general-purpose debiasing method that can be used in any context where the Riesz representation can be estimated.
our method is a general-purpose debiasing method that can be used with any machine learning model.

we propose an automatic debiaser that is simple to use and can be implemented in any machine learning framework, and that is competitive with the best performing state of the art method for the problem of causal effects estimation.
The main takeaway from our work is that
automatic debiasing is possible, and can outperform the state of the art.
automatic debiasing can be achieved without a functional-specific theoretical analysis, but rather by automatically learning the Reisz representation of the linear functionals.
debiasing methods based on automatic representation learning of functionals can be a viable alternative to the current state of the art methods based on functional influence function estimation.
